description:
Search the chain's hotels (worldwide, several thousand) by location, stars, brand, status and amenities, with pagination.

    All filters are optional and combined with AND. Always pass `country` (ISO code, e.g. "FR") together with `city`
    when the country is known or implied: a search on "Paris" alone returns Paris (Kentucky, US) and
    Paris (Ontario, CA) before Paris (France).

    Returns {"language", "total", "offset", "limit", "count", "next_offset", "hotels"}: `total` is the number of matching hotels,
    `next_offset` is null on the last page. Each hotel is a summary (hotel_id, name, brand, city, country, state,
    stars, status, lat, lng, cover_photo); use get_hotel_details for the full record.

    Geographic search: give a center (lat + lng, or near_hotel_id) and radius_km. Results are then sorted by
    distance, each hotel gets a `distance_km` field and the response a `center` field. Coordinates you supply
    for a landmark are approximate, so prefer a generous radius. Hotels without coordinates are excluded.

    No availability, rates or booking: this tool only returns descriptive information.

brand.description: Partial match on the sub-brand, ignoring case and accents (e.g. 'Plus', 'Premier', 'Signature Collection')
brand.title: Brand

city.description: City name, partial match ignoring case, accents, hyphens and St/Ste abbreviations (e.g. 'Saint-Étienne' = 'saint etienne' = 'St Etienne'; 'Saint' matches every city containing 'Saint'). If no city matches, the response lists close city names in `city_suggestions`. City names are ambiguous worldwide: combine with `country` whenever the country is known.
city.title: City

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase (FR, US, CA, DE...). Strongly recommended together with `city` to avoid homonyms (Paris FR vs Paris US/CA).
country.title: Country

language.description: Language of the multilingual fields of the results. Accepted values: fr, en, de, it, es. A text missing in the requested language is returned in French.
language.title: Language

lat.description: Latitude of the search center (-90 to 90). Use with `lng` and `radius_km`.
lat.title: Lat

limit.description: Maximum number of hotels to return (1-100)
limit.title: Limit

lng.description: Longitude of the search center (-180 to 180). Use with `lat` and `radius_km`.
lng.title: Lng

min_stars.description: Minimum star rating (1-5). Hotels without a star rating are excluded when set. For an exact rating, filter the results on their `stars` field.
min_stars.title: Min Stars

near_hotel_id.description: Use this hotel's coordinates as the search center (instead of lat/lng) to find other hotels around it; the hotel itself is excluded. Use with `radius_km`.
near_hotel_id.title: Near Hotel Id

offset.description: Number of matching hotels to skip, for pagination. Pass the `next_offset` value of the previous response.
offset.title: Offset

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres (up to 200). Required with lat/lng or near_hotel_id.
radius_km.title: Radius Km

required_amenities.description: Amenity IDs the hotel must ALL have, uppercase (e.g. ["POOL", "PARKING"]). Unknown IDs raise an error listing the valid ones; the catalogue is also available via get_amenities without hotel_id.
required_amenities.title: Required Amenities

name: search_hotels

distance_km.description: Distance from the search center, only for geographic searches
distance_km.title: Distance Km

center.description: Center of a geographic search: {lat, lng, radius_km}, plus near_hotel_id if used
center.title: Center

city_suggestions.description: When `city` matches no hotel: close city names to retry with
city_suggestions.title: City Suggestions

count.description: Number of hotels in this page
count.title: Count

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page, null on the last page
next_offset.title: Next Offset

total.description: Number of hotels matching the filters
total.title: Total

title: Search hotels
